text: A hundred grams of avocado, a hundred of cucumber: same weight, about ten times the calories.
Avocado: about a hundred sixty calories, fifteen grams of fat, seven of fiber.
Cucumber: about fifteen calories, and ninety-five percent water.
Fat packs about nine calories a gram; water has none.
Neither is bad: calorie for calorie, a hundred grams of avocado equals about a kilo of cucumber.
